text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days after Mejiro Ardan's debut race, I pay her a visit while she recuperates at her family's rest house.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: I presume you're here to see Lady Ardan? Allow me to lead the way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I follow after Mejiro Ardan's nanny and, a short distance from the rest house, we reach a small woodland area where Mejiro Ardan is relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hello there, Trainer. How lovely that you've come to see me.
choice_data_list: …How's your body feeling?
…How's your body feeling?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's absolutely fine. The chief physician said that I've regained my strength and am at least as healthy as I was before my debut.
choice_data_list: That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, would you care to take a nice, relaxing stroll with me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I wish to speak with you in private.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan takes me to an elevated clearing on a small hill past the woods.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: This moment, right now, is a critical juncture for you.
choice_data_list: Do you mean—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I can hazard a good guess at how your conversation with my physician went the other day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The man is my family's most esteemed physician, and I've known him since I was little. As such, I trust him as much as I do Nanny.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And accordingly, anything he's said regarding my condition… is to be trusted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That said…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Even if his concerns regarding my body are justified… and even if the path I tread is as treacherous as thin ice…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shan't ever give up.
choice_data_list: Ardan…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But of course, this decision reflects only my wishes… and not yours, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I believe that by now, you must know all too well how unreliable and hazy an individual I can be. I even collapsed after my debut race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, if you do choose to stay by my side…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You'll be managing a racer as fragile and delicate as a glass ornament.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Could you still adorn me on the track… knowing that you might end up breaking me?
choice_data_list: I could.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: But I will never break you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan looks at me like she's puzzling something over. I've already decided how I'm going to answer her question.
choice_data_list: I'd like to show you something.
I'd like to show you something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You've… something to show me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take out my tablet and hand it to Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Is this… a race agenda… and a training regimen? And not just one, but multiple variations?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Th-this can't be—
choice_data_list: This is the extent of my resolve.
This is the extent of my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The tablet I showed Mejiro Ardan contains a slew of race agendas and training plans I've devised for her junior year and onwards.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Those plans also incorporate every foreseeable scenario I could think of pertaining to Mejiro Ardan's health and well-being.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer… Does this mean… You understood what I was trying to say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Of course I do. The way she's testing me with this talk of consequences… I know she's just pushing me away out of kindness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The thing is, I don't want kindness. I want something else…
choice_data_list: Ardan, I wish to remain as your trainer.
Ardan, I wish to remain as your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's because I want to remain as her trainer that I've thought about what I should do in that role, and what she might want from me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide that now's the time to put my answer into words. As Mejiro Ardan's trainer…
choice_data_list: I won't let your light go out.
I won't let your light go out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I'll make sure to protect her fragile body, so she'll be able to shine on in all her races, now and forever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And to help her—this racer who lives in the moment, and only has eyes for the now…
choice_data_list: I'll forge a path to your future.
I'll forge a path to your future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It was after my debut race… The evening of the day I was transferred to the family rest house…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …That night, I had a dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In my dream, I heard the sound of glass cracking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The sensation of everything spilling out from my fractured body was so cold, so vivid…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I couldn't put that dream behind me… And so today, I found myself questioning you, in a manner most uncouth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I'm truly, terribly sorry for that.
choice_data_list: If anything, I'm glad you did put those questions to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Oh?
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, my resolve is stronger than ever.
Thanks to you, my resolve is stronger than ever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer…
choice_data_list: Please let me accompany you on your journey.
Please let me accompany you on your journey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …How could I ever refuse?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I would love to have you beside me as we continue this journey…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, Mejiro Ardan and I go and speak with her physician.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: I hereby acknowledge both of your intentions.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: As Lady Ardan's chief physician, I hereby give her my formal permission to return to the academy.
choice_data_list: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: However, note that I may have to rescind this decision in the event that something were to happen to Lady Ardan again.
choice_data_list: Duly noted.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: …This is little more than my personal opinion, but I fully support the decision you've both made.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: Feel free to come to me with any concerns you might have. Now though, I shall be taking my leave.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Trainer, it sounds like he believes in you as well.
choice_data_list: I'll do everything I possibly can to meet his expectations.
I'll do everything I possibly can to meet his expectations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. And so will I.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, Mejiro Ardan's nanny drives the two of us from the rest house back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you for dropping us off, Nanny.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: I've informed the master and mistress of today's developments.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh. I've just written Father and Mother a letter myself, to let them know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall message you once I've arrived at the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: My lady. As you walk this path you've committed yourself to… please do take care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall. I'll not for a moment forget that I've chosen the steepest, most strenuous path of all.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: I'll be thinking of you, always. Best of luck to you.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: …Please take good care of Lady Ardan.
choice_data_list: You have my word.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan's nanny bows deeply upon hearing my response, then leaves without uttering another word.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming to see me today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now, concerning our plans moving forward…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I was wondering if perhaps I could trouble you to decide on each of the races I'll be running during my junior year.
choice_data_list: Of course. Are you sure you don't mind me choosing all of them, though?
Of course. Are you sure you don't mind me choosing all of them, though?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Not at all. Because I've made a decision of my own today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I've decided to pursue the future that you have laid out for me.
choice_data_list: Ardan…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As such, I ask for your guidance on what I ought to focus on now, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing her say that, I feel as if Mejiro Ardan… might be placing a little more trust in me than she was before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My determination to support her grows stronger yet—she's putting her life in my hands!
choice_data_list: Let's work on improving, little by little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What Mejiro Ardan needs right now is both hands-on experience and the physical capacity to last an entire race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During her junior year, I plan to have her continue training as she accumulates actual racing experience at a pace that suits her.
choice_data_list: After that, we can aim for a grander stage for you to shine on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Very well. In other words, it appears as though it's time for me to undergo quite some rigorous training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I shall be counting on you once again, Trainer, starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With both of us fully prepared for what lies ahead, Mejiro Ardan and I welcome her junior year!
